name: Shelter Me
overview: SHELTER ME celebrates the human-animal bond and highlights important social issues with the help of companion animals. Episodes of this Emmy Award-winning series have been hosted by John Legend, Jane Goodall, Jon Hamm, Edie Falco, Kristen Bell, Hilary Swank, Allison Janney and Jane Lynch. Topics explored include innovative work with veterans, Alzheimer patients, the incarcerated and the homeless.
